summary:
Found and fixed the needle. In `app/app.py:28`, the pagination offset was computed as `(page - 1) * per_page - (1 if page > 1 else 0)` — the extra `- 1` for pages after the first shifted every subsequent page back by one item, so page 2 started with the last item of page 1 (a duplicate at every page boundary). I removed the subtraction so the offset is the standard `(page - 1) * per_page`.

`test.sh` now passes: `PASS: Pagination is correct across page boundaries`.
